reconstructed_theorem_text: For every pair of complete second-countable metric spaces E,F equipped with their Borel measurable structures, every probability measure mu on E and nu on F, and every continuous function c:E times F to finite nonnegative reals, there exists a measure gamma on E times F which is a probability, has first marginal mu and second marginal nu, and satisfies the extended nonnegative integral equality integral(c,gamma)=inf{integral(c,eta): eta is a raw measure with first marginal mu and second marginal nu}. The cost is cast to extended nonnegative reals for integration. Both sides take values in [0,infinity], and the minimum is not asserted finite. No boundedness, finite integral or additional moment hypothesis is imposed. There are no numerical constants.
